30eddac6e8.q: What is the average tenure of service advisors in automotive dealerships and how does it compare to showroom sales positions?
30eddac6e8.a: The average tenure for service advisors is now just under two and a half years, down three years in a row by shaving off a few months each year. This metric has fallen to the same level as showroom floor salespeople, which has historically been a notorious turnover area, making advisor retention a major issue for dealerships.
30eddac6e8.e: "From Turnover to Tenure: Mastering Advisor Retention in Auto Dealerships" w/ Rick Ulin Education Team Lead/ Lead Instructor NCM Kansas City
30eddac6e8.rq: People don't quit their job, they quit their leadership.
ks: Average service advisor tenure: just under 2.5 years (down 3 years in a row)
Current industry benchmark: 407 production hours per advisor per month
Target production: 500 hours per month to support 3 technicians at 100% proficiency
Recommended closure rate on technician recommendations: 40%
Hours per RO benchmark: 8 hours per tech per day (currently under this threshold)

cf1ce4ef1e.q: What production benchmark should a service advisor achieve monthly to support the shop's technician workforce?
cf1ce4ef1e.a: 500 hours of production in a month is needed to support approximately three technicians at full proficiency. The current industry benchmark is 407 hours per advisor per month, though this figure has been affected by CDK system filtering and should normalize by August.
